We are a small farm animal rescue for Pot Belly Pigs, Goats, Donkeys and Dogs. Our mission is to provide a safe place for neglected, abused, unwanted and surrendered farm animals. We will also provide education on the animals.

Welcome to the Last Resort Farm Animal Rescue. We are starting the New Year with a new goal. we have taken in many pot belly pigs lately and found that there needs to be a rescue and education on farm animals as pets. Join us on our journey to provide farm animals with the care they need. This will be a lot of work and entertainment.
